about: Curated input of the UI hazard scan (python -m civ5headless.hazards). methods: DLL Lua methods known to change game state although the source derivation misses them or names them less clearly. engine: Lua calls that the real game turns into DLL calls and the host does not. notHazards: derived methods that do not change state after all (vetted). harmlessCaches: functions that write a cache whose value does not depend on when it is computed (lookup indexes, scratch buffers); the derivation does not follow them.

methods.name: Rand
methods.why: advances the game's synchronised random number generator (CvGame::getJonRandNum): every later random draw changes

methods.name: Rand
methods.why: advances the map random number generator (CvGame::getMapRandNum)

methods.name: CalculateGoldRate
methods.why: stock BNW and VP before the 2026 determinism fix: the treasury cost calculation stores the unit maintenance (CvTreasury::m_iExpensePerTurnUnitMaintenance, saved)

methods.name: GetMilitaryMight
methods.why: lazy: recomputed at most once per turn (stock: elapsed turn, VP: turn slice) and stored; which caller comes first decides the stored value

methods.name: GetPower
methods.why: calls the military might getter (lazy, as GetMilitaryMight)

engine.why: in the real game a network message that the DLL applies (CvDllNetMessageHandler); the host's Network table does nothing

notHazards.name: CreateFreeLuxuryCheck
notHazards.why: checks whether a free luxury can be created; no write
